pet_notes: Original chibi Umbra witch mascot, tall elegant attitude compressed into a compact readable pet silhouette; confident expression and poised gun-kata body language; hairstyle inspired specifically by Bayonetta 1: extremely long black hair arranged into a tall sculptural beehive-like updo with a long flowing tail, never a short bob; costume inspired specifically by Bayonetta 2: black-and-midnight-blue ornate bodysuit with silver filigree and blue ribbon accents; exactly four compact blue-and-silver pistols inspired by Bayonetta 2, two hand-held and two attached at the heels, all physically attached and kept inside the silhouette; ornate spectacles; no logos, no readable text, no direct game asset copying.
style_notes: Polished stylized 3D collectible-toy rendering, anime chibi proportions, crisp silhouette, large expressive face and glasses, glossy black and midnight-blue materials with restrained silver ornament and subtle red accents; preserve the tall long-hair silhouette from Bayonetta 1 and outfit plus pistols language from Bayonetta 2 in every frame.
style_contract: Pet-safe sprite: compact full-body mascot, readable in a 192x208 cell, clear silhouette, simple face, stable palette/materials, and crisp edges for chroma-key extraction. Style `3d-toy`: Stylized 3D toy mascot with smooth rounded forms, simple materials, clear silhouette, and no photoreal complexity.
